identity.name: Eastern Shores
identity.notes: Gated residential community in North Miami Beach, Miami-Dade County, Florida. Publicly documented specifics on this community (exact HOA/CDD fees, amenity list, community-level demographics) are not well established in my knowledge base, so no fee or amenity facts are reported. Demographics and proximity items provided are city/area-level approximations for the North Miami Beach area and are flagged with low confidence.

fees.note: Official ESPOA (Eastern Shores Property Owners' Association) site FAQ: 'members pay their $50 annual dues'; dues typically due at beginning of calendar year; no late fees. Dues cover community management, common area maintenance, communications, event coordination, advocacy at city meetings, and shared neighborhood infrastructure maintenance. This is the POA/neighborhood dues, separate from any condominium building association fees. Conflicts with third-party aggregators claiming 'no traditional HOA fees' for most single-family homes (see other fee facts). Also note: a separate 'Eastern Shores Community Apartments HOA' (co-op, 3741 NE 170th St, est. 1960) exists per florida-hoa.net - different association from ESPOA. No CDD assessments found in any source reviewed. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Aggregator (hoabulletinboard): 'Public sources indicate no traditional HOA fees for most single-family homes; fees apply to condominium sub-associations. Exact figures for the POA are unavailable from public records.' Conflicts with official ESPOA site's $50 annual dues. ESPOA registered address 16422 NE 34 Avenue, NMB 33160; city admin/guardhouse hotline 305-354-4420; email easternshoresadmin@citynmb.com. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Aggregator reporting listing-site figures: 'Condo fees in the area vary, e.g., monthly dues reported around $427-$986 in listings' for condominium sub-associations within Eastern Shores. Unverified listing data; confirm with individual building associations. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

For the separate 'Eastern Shores Community Apartments HOA' (EASTERN SHORES COMMUNITY APTS INC, co-op, est. 1960, 3741 NE 170th St, NMB 33160): 'Association HOA Fee: HOA Fee Required' - amount not published. Property manager: FPMS, Sarasota FL, 941-960-5000. Amenities listed: Community Pool, Gated Community. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

amenities.detail: Guard-gated peninsula community; 24/7 manned guard gate installed 1997; dedicated on-site fire rescue station; administered via City of North Miami Beach Eastern Shores Administration (305-354-4420). (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)
Buyer FAQ: 'Access is limited to a single staffed entrance off NE 35th Avenue, which keeps traffic patterns controlled and through-traffic minimal.' (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Annual ESPOA dues cover community management, common area maintenance, communications, event coordination, advocacy at city meetings, and maintenance of shared neighborhood infrastructure; online payment via member portal; no late fees. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Monthly bulk trash pickup (curbside, 3rd Thursday of each month, city-scheduled); community portal with documents/CC&Rs, maintenance requests, events; 500+ Eastern Shores homeowners per board site. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Listing-site amenity list: 24/7 security, community center, private boat docks, swimming pools, iPic Theater. Also: 300 total homes, 2,900-9,340 sqft, Gated: Yes, Pet Restrictions: Pets Allowed, Year Built 1950, HOA: No (note: 'HOA No' conflicts with official ESPOA existence). (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Single-family homes sit along deep-water canals; most lots have direct navigable access to the Intracoastal Waterway via Maule Lake with no fixed bridges; ocean access via Haulover Inlet typically 10-20 minutes by boat; lots usually ~7,000-10,000 sqft. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Official City of North Miami Beach page: shelter and benches installed at the tot lot at NE 166th St & NE 35th Ave (completed Nov 2001); 4-foot sidewalks east of 35th Ave; decorative bus shelters; street light upgrades. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

'Amenities center on the gated entrance, security features, and shared recreational spaces such as a basketball court and playground near the guardhouse. Many properties feature private docks and waterfront access.' (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

'Pet Restrictions: Pets Allowed' (listing-site data; no detailed breed/size rules published in sources reviewed). Trulia resident reviews also describe the area as dog-friendly. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

Low-confidence (AI-generated wiki): community facilities include a dedicated fire rescue station, basketball court, playground, and shaded tot lot; 322-acre peninsula; over 2,000 housing units; adjacent to Oleta River State Park. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

demographics.geography_level: City (North Miami Beach, FL) - NOT community-specific; Eastern Shores is a neighborhood within the city. Source states data from 2019-2023 ACS 5-year estimates (citing U.S. Census Bureau). Median age 39; 15,303 households; 52.2% owner-occupied / 47.8% renter; average household income $83,227 (2024); median gross rent $1,750; ~40.4% Black, ~28.5% two-or-more races, ~20.8% White per page. (Retrieved ~2026-10-05.)

open_questions: Fee conflict: official ESPOA site states a $50 annual dues for members, while hoabulletinboard.com (two pages) says 'no traditional HOA fees for most single-family homes; fees apply to condominium sub-associations.' Could not reconcile - verify current dues directly with ESPOA (305-354-4420 or easternshoresadmin@citynmb.com) or the board.
Condominium sub-association monthly fees reported only as a '$427-$986' range from listing sites via an aggregator - not verified against any individual building's association documents.
No CDD (Community Development District) or special assessment information found for Eastern Shores in any source reviewed; unknown whether a CDD exists for the area.
The allinmiami.com buyer FAQ's 'Are there HOA fees in Eastern Shores?' section was truncated in my page read (cut off at 'Most...') - full answer could not be captured.

Distances in miles were not published on any source I could read; shopping/grocery/school proximity is given as drive minutes only (3-10 min). Jackson Memorial Hospital is reportedly ~13 miles from North Miami Beach per a Rome2rio search snippet, but that page could not be read to verify.

Community-level demographics not found: no Census tract or neighborhood-level ACS data for Eastern Shores itself was located. City of North Miami Beach figures (pop ~43,898, median age ~39.1, median HH income $63,280, 52.2% owner-occupied, 2019-2023 ACS via point2homes.com; corroborated by florida-demographics.com) are used as area-level approximations only. Grokipedia claims a 2010 Census neighborhood population of 5,756 (47.26% Hispanic, $39,902 per capita income) but that is an unverified AI-generated source.

Homes.com and flyhomes.com neighborhood guides (which would have had neighborhood demographics) were blocked/unreadable; Trulia's guide only provided resident sentiment (93% say walkable to restaurants, 73% say walkable to grocery stores, 73% say dog friendly).
Resident count conflicts: buysouthflorida.com lists 300 homes; ESPOA's site advertises to '500+ Eastern Shores homeowners'; Grokipedia claims 2,000+ housing units - actual count unverified.

iPic Theater is listed as an 'on-site' amenity by buysouthflorida.com, but iPic North Miami Beach appears to be a tenant inside Intracoastal Mall (3-minute drive) per the allinmiami shopping guide - likely nearby rather than on-site.
Pet policy details (breed/size restrictions, condo vs single-family differences) not published in sources reviewed; only 'Pets Allowed' from listing data.
